# Vinyl Shelf

> A 3D record shelf over your music folder. Pull out an album and it plays on a vinyl player.

Vinyl Shelf is a web page (one self-contained index.html) that reads a music folder in the browser,
groups the files into albums by their tags, and shows them as LP records on an oak cube shelf.
Pulling a record out shows its cover and, turned over, its tracklist by side. Playing it hands
the album to one of six browser vinyl players over a small postMessage protocol, vinyl-shelf/1.
Nothing is uploaded; only tags and small covers are kept in the browser's IndexedDB.

- Live: https://gitguy268.github.io/vinyl-shelf/
- Source: https://github.com/Gitguy268/vinyl-shelf
- Protocol: https://github.com/Gitguy268/vinyl-shelf/blob/main/docs/PROTOCOL.md
- Licence: MIT
